roles.responsibility: Verify series, edition, hierarchy, assignment rules, code boundaries and correspondence semantics.
Verify national adoption, local extensions, language, effective dates and regulatory use.
Verify specialist overlay meaning, boundary cases, operational units and analytical relevance.
Verify direct support, locator, source authority, freshness, limitations and defeaters.
Bind analytical cases, source systems and data shapes to registered industry scope without reducing cases to KPIs.

review_requirements: No person may be both the sole author and sole adjudicator of a semantic boundary or lossy crosswalk.
Official imports need a classification-steward check of source digest, counts and parser behavior before ratification.
Lossy, partial, cross-axis, jurisdiction-changing or allocation-bearing mappings require both a classification steward and a domain or jurisdiction specialist.
A mapping cannot advance beyond official_import while either reviewer field is null.
Per-industry completion requires an evidence reviewer independent from the vertical pack's primary author.
Review records must state the exact artifact edition and review date; review does not float to future editions.
Conflicting authoritative sources create an evidence_conflict gap and block adjudication until resolved.
review_checklist: Boundary notes, inclusions, exclusions and residual categories considered
Crosswalk relation, direction, cardinality, extent and allocation tested
Evidence locator directly supports the claim
Downstream analytical cases bind to the intended node
No product boundary or capability ownership inferred from classification membership
mandatory_re_review_triggers: failed reproducibility digest or row-count gate
vertical research discovers a boundary not expressible by current nodes
